reason: When family comes in from out of town I need somewhere close to Ala Moana for a real Korean meal, and a bowl of naengmyeon under twenty dollars is fair for Honolulu. I would go once, but I would steer everyone to the noodles and share one kalbi, not order kalbi for everybody.
objection: With family we are always five or more, so that 20% gratuity gets added automatically on top of tax. Kalbi at almost forty dollars a plate for six people turns into a three-hundred-dollar dinner fast.
would_change_my_mind: If the gratuity was not automatic for groups, or there was a family set or combo price for a big table, I would bring visitors there every time instead of just once.
